name: comp-476

frames.best_why: Full matrix with every rotated header and all three rows visible, unhovered and unclipped.

tagline: Grid of green ticks and red crosses showing CSS support per browser.
summary: A feature support matrix: three CSS features run down the left, ten desktop and mobile browsers run across the top in sideways labels, and each cell holds a green tick or red cross with the version number.
appearance: A dense grid of faint white cell borders on black. Browser names are rotated to read bottom-to-top along the top edge, with a monitor icon over the desktop half and a phone icon over the mobile half. Feature names sit left, and every cell pairs a small green tick or red cross with a grey version number.
behaviour: Almost nothing moves: hovering a row tints that whole strip of cells a slightly lighter grey so the eye can track across all ten browsers. No cell is clickable.
demo_content: Three CSS features (scroll-timeline, view-timeline, font-size-adjust) tested on ten desktop and mobile browsers.
search_phrases: browser support table for css features
matrix of green ticks and red crosses
feature support across desktop and mobile
grid showing what each browser can do
use_when: Developers need to show at a glance which browsers support a short list of web features.
avoid_when: The three features and their 2024-era versions are fixed in the file, so your own data means a source edit.
customise: Features, browser lists and support flags sit in an items array inside the file; adding a feature or changing versions is a source edit, while borders and text follow theme tokens.
weight_why: Three rows of plain cells with inline SVG icons; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Icons are hidden from screen readers but each cell adds hidden "Supported" or "Not supported" text, and both browser groups have hidden headings.

issues: Support data is fixed to three features and old browser versions, so it ages quickly.
Version text is tiny and low contrast against the black background.
polish_why: Sharp, scannable matrix with clear icons and tidy dividers; only the tiny version text is dim.
title: Feature Compatibility Table
